name: @workspace/tool-logic-password-hash
description: The Password Hash tool's logic (D14, docs/tools/specs/password-hash.md): bcrypt, Argon2, scrypt and PBKDF2 password hashes on hash-wasm, their encoded strings (modular crypt, PHC, passlib, libsodium, Django, htpasswd), reading and checking them with a constant-time comparison, the parameter limits and today's recommendations. Pure TypeScript: no React, no DOM, no chrome.
